partner.title: That's the client experience, end to end.
partner.body: Every client who runs The Forge lands in The Refinery with all of this pre-loaded. As a partner, you get an anonymous statistical overview of your cohort. It never includes their resume content.

refinery.title: The Refinery aims your resume at real jobs.
refinery.body: The Forge makes one general resume. In The Refinery you tailor it to one job at a time, practice interviews, plan what to say about your record, and use a job board that marks employers we checked for hiring people with records. When you create your free account, your story and the answers you gave in the Forge can be saved there with your corrected resume. Check that this page says your version is saved before you leave. You can also download a copy.
refinery.seatlessNote: The Refinery opens with a seat from an organization. You can ask for one.

nextStep.letter: Troy's letter comes out Sunday and Wednesday. It's short and practical. <link>Read it here</link>.

review.title: Got three minutes? Tell us how it really went.
review.body: Good or bad, your honest review helps other people find these tools and helps us improve them. We want to keep the Forge free for the next person, too.
review.note: Your work stays here. The review opens in a new tab; come back here to continue into the Refinery. Reviewing is optional.

tour.storyText: t.ROY read the work you gave us and wrote this. It is a starting account in his words. If the headline misses you, say so and he redoes it.
tour.resumeText: This is your first stronger draft, built from your experience. Read it, make it yours, then use the Refinery to tailor it to a real job and practice your story.
tour.didText: Every fix he made and anything he left out because it needed a fact only you could give. Open it to see each one. Nothing here is a mistake you have to fix.
tour.checkedText: Every line we asked about is settled. You can still change an answer.
tour.openText: For each one: say it's true, change it, or cut it. When they're done, your resume is finished.
tour.downloadFinished: Download your resume and cover letter here, or email them to yourself. A copy was also saved to your account.
tour.downloadDraft: Download here. Until it is finished, every file is marked DRAFT so nobody mistakes it for the final one.
tour.checksText: These checks read your page the way a screener does. Open one for the detail. They are for your information. You don't have to act on them.
tour.nextText: Your resume carries over. The Refinery tailors it to real jobs, writes cover letters, and prepares you for interviews.
